📰 General

Taco Bell & Chipotle Linked to Rising Cyclospora Outbreak Across the US •

A growing outbreak of cyclosporiasis, a parasitic illness, is linked to consumption of food from Taco Bell and Chipotle restaurants across the United States. As of July 15th, Michigan health officials reported 4,312 confirmed cases and 121 hospitalizations since the outbreak began in June. Investigations are ongoing to determine the source of the contamination, with no definitive link established yet. Public health officials are advising consumers to be aware of the symptoms and to report any illness to their healthcare provider.

🌍 World

Israeli Government Approves Controversial Legislation Ahead of Election

The Israeli government, led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, passed several significant laws in the lead-up to the upcoming national election. These laws, facing strong opposition, are intended to weaken judicial review and bolster support for specific media organizations. Critics argue the legislation represents a substantial shift towards authoritarian tendencies within the country’s legal system. The measures are expected to be a key point of contention during the election campaign.

🦅 US

Texas Hill Country Faces Flash Flood Emergency Due to Intense Rainfall •

Torrential rainfall across the Texas Hill Country has triggered flash flood emergency warnings as of Thursday morning. Rapidly rising water levels in creeks and rivers are the primary concern, with the situation expected to persist through Thursday. Emergency officials are monitoring the waterways and advising residents in affected areas to take precautions. The intense weather system has caused significant flooding, prompting evacuations in some locations. Authorities are continuing to assess the extent of the damage and potential impacts.

💰 Business

Truth Social Announces Direct Data Sales to Wall Street Firms •

Truth Social, the social media platform founded by Donald Trump, announced it will provide Wall Street firms with immediate access to posts made by the former president. The company, owned by Trump Media & Technology Group, stated this move will allow financial institutions to react more quickly to market-moving announcements. This direct data offering is intended to enhance the platform’s value and attract greater investment. The move represents a significant shift in how Trump Media & Technology Group intends to monetize its user base.

💻 Technology

Marathon Gets a Major Boost: New PVE Content Arrives This Fall •

Bungie is releasing a significant mid-season update for Marathon, following a period of studio restructuring and inactivity. The update introduces a “roguelite” version of the Cryo Archive raid, expanding the game’s PVE content substantially. This new mode will feature extraction shooter elements and is intended to be a substantial addition to the game’s existing PVE offerings. Bungie anticipates this update will revitalize the game’s community and provide a fresh experience for players.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya graced the 2024 Met Gala with a breathtaking custom Valentino Haute Couture gown designed by Pierpaolo Piccioli. The dress featured a dramatic, floor-length silhouette with intricate embellishments and a deep V-neckline. She accessorized with Tiffany & Co. jewelry and a stunning diamond bracelet. The event celebrated the theme "Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion," and Zendaya’s appearance was widely considered a highlight.

🏅 Sports

Kerr’s Cryptic Response to Fan’s LeBron James Question Sparks Buzz •

During a stoplight encounter, Golden State Warriors head coach Steve Kerr was asked by a fan when he planned to acquire LeBron James. Kerr responded with the enigmatic phrase, “Oh, we got…” leaving the question unanswered. The interaction was captured on video and quickly went viral across social media platforms. The Warriors’ general manager, Mike Dunleavy Jr., confirmed the exchange occurred. The team has not issued an official statement regarding the comment.

🔬 Science

Scientists Discover Earth-Like Exoplanet With Potential for Liquid Water •

Astronomers have identified an atmosphere surrounding LHS 1140b, an exoplanet located 49 light-years from Earth. Spectral analysis indicates the presence of water vapor in the planet’s atmosphere, suggesting the possibility of liquid water on its surface. The planet, roughly 1.4 times the size of Earth, orbits a red dwarf star within its habitable zone. This discovery represents a significant step in the ongoing search for potentially habitable worlds beyond our solar system.

🩺 Health

New Study Links Gut Bacteria to Increased Risk of Alzheimer’s Disease •

Researchers at the University of Minnesota have identified a specific gut bacteria composition that correlates with an elevated risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease. The study, published in Alzheimer’s & Dementia, examined the gut microbiome of over 150 individuals, including those with and without the disease. Participants with a higher abundance of Desulfovibrio bacteria showed a significantly increased risk of cognitive decline. Scientists believe this bacteria produces compounds that may contribute to inflammation in the brain, a key factor in Alzheimer’s progression.
